meta.name: Generate Image (FLUX 3 Image Klein, Mac)
meta.licenseNote: FLUX 3 Image Klein (Black Forest Labs) under its own flux-3-image-klein license; the MLX files are mflux-community's conversion (same licence). Bring your own files; Get AI Models offers them on a Mac.
meta.notes: Runs natively on a Mac (genai-native gn-diffusion flux3-klein/image on gn-mlx, MLX): Klein's distilled 16-step flow map at the asked size, no prompt upsampler. The Mac's quality pick for Generate; MOSS Turbo stays the default. q4 on a 16 GB M1 Air: about 95 s at 512², about 6.5 min at 1024².
